expected_legal_description:
ALL that certain tract or parcel of land and premises situate in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, and the State of New Jersey, described as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, where intersected by the Southerly line of Lot 12.13, Block 76 and running;

(1) Along said Northeasterly line of Lot 10, Block 76, North 32 degrees 22 minutes 34 seconds West, 41.23 feet to a point in same;

(2) Along the common line of Lots 12.12 and 12.13, Block 76, North 61 degrees 11 minutes 34 seconds East, 82.47 feet to a point in the Southwesterly line of Lot 12.07, Block 76; thence

(3) Along said Southeasterly line of Lot 12.07, South 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds East, 36.73 feet to a point in the Northerly line of Lot 13, Block 76; thence

(4) Along said Northerly line of Lot 13, South 58 degrees 01 minutes 30 seconds West, 79.90 feet, to the point and place of BEGINNING.

Subject to all right of ways, easements and restrictions of record.

Being known as Lot 12.13, Block 76 as shown on Plan of Lots “Willits Court”, dated January 20, 2004, prepared by James T. Sapio, L.S., License #17780 of JTS Engineering and Land Surveyors, Inc., filed 5/21/04 in Book 902, page 15.

Under and Subject Declaration of Covenants and Restrictions for “Willits Court Homeowner’s Association”, to be recorded.

For Information Purposes Only: Block 76, Lot 12.13, on the Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.

Survey made by James A. Conway, Jr., P.L.S., NJ License No. GS43235 of Bach Associates, P C, dated 6/1/04.
